rules:
The first line of the input contains integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 100). This value shows the number of sets of test data in the input. Next follows the description of each of the t tests on a separate line.

The description of each test is a string consisting of 12 characters, each character is either "X", or "O". The i-th character of the string shows the character that is written on the i-th card from the start. Unique token result under retained description; generated qualification and independent oracle/audit outstanding.
